title: SlotFill: Repairing Lossy SoC Communication Traces for Post-Silicon Validation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31313v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-silicon validation relies on traces of messages exchanged by SoC components, but trace buffers and monitors drop messages, often leaving no mark of what was lost. We present SlotFill, which puts each deleted message back in the right gap, with the right type and order. SlotFill gives every gap between the remaining messages a fixed number of slots, and a Transformer-based model fills each slot with a message or leaves it empty when nothing was deleted there, so the input never reveals how much was lost. The model also uses monitor fields (timestamps, transaction IDs, addresses) from surviving messages. On whole-program gem5 traces of 4- and 8-core systems (2.07 billion messages), SlotFill restores up to 97% of deleted messages exactly at 15% loss and up to 87% at 50% loss, and 76-83% at 15% loss when timestamps are coarse.

translated_title: SlotFill：面向流片后验证的有损SoC通信踪迹修复方法
translated_abstract: 流片后验证依赖于SoC组件之间交换消息的踪迹，但踪迹缓冲区和监视器会丢失消息，且通常不会留下任何丢失标记。我们提出SlotFill，它将每条被删除的消息放回正确的间隙中，并恢复正确的类型和顺序。SlotFill为剩余消息之间的每个间隙分配固定数量的槽位，由基于Transformer的模型在每个槽位中填入一条消息，或在该处没有消息被删除时留空，因此输入不会泄露到底丢失了多少消息。该模型还利用了存活消息中的监视器字段（时间戳、事务ID、地址）。在4核和8核系统的完整程序gem5踪迹（20.7亿条消息）上，SlotFill在15%丢失率下可精确恢复高达97%的已删除消息，在50%丢失率下可恢复高达87%；当时间戳较粗糙时，在15%丢失率下仍能恢复76-83%。
tldr: SlotFill通过为消息间隙分配固定槽位并利用基于Transformer的模型结合监视器字段信息，在流片后验证中精确恢复SoC通信踪迹中丢失的消息，在15%丢失率下恢复率高达97%。
en_tdlr: SlotFill employs a Transformer-based model with fixed slots per gap and monitor fields to precisely restore lost messages in SoC communication traces for post-silicon validation, recovering up to 97% of deleted messages at 15% loss.
